notice: Original Future Fit development/pilot items. Use to validate the product and scoring flow. Do not market as a validated psychometric instrument until expert review and validation studies are complete.

assessment.name: Future Fit Interest Assessment (Pilot)
assessment.description: A bilingual India-focused pilot that helps students explore the kinds of activities they may enjoy. This pilot validates the Future Fit assessment flow and is not yet a psychometrically validated instrument.
